I blow dry my hair, and it was very manageable and not at all frizzy after using WEN. It felt like a heavy conditioner when I put it on, but it cleans so nicely! reviews.x: I really loved this product for the first two days... after that... not so much. I had really high hopes for it so I went into it with a positive attitude. I've been using it for weeks now so I feel like I can write an accurate review. First of all, it tells you to use 30 pumps on your hair if you have long hair. That is basically the whole bottle... so if you can afford to spend $30 on every shampoo, maybe it will work better for you. I used one pump on the top of my hair, one pump on the botto

I have used this for two days now and can't believe how better my hair looks and feels.  I was skeptical at first due to all the shampoos, conditioners and hair products I have tried.  I had really dry frizzy hair and it looks like its got some life back to it.  I hope it continues to work well.

Noticed the difference in my hair the first time I used it and it just keeps getting better and better after every use. I’m getting compliments every day and everyone wants to know what I’m using on my hair because it looks so healthy!  a little pricey but worth it

reviews.t: My hair is soft, grows, has volume. Love Wen!
reviews.x: Love Wen Cleansing Conditioner. My hair is fine and sometimes gets oily with other shampoos and conditioners. I color my hair regularly and live in a very dry climate, so it can tangle easily and become damaged. When I started using Wen, I noticed a positive change right away. I've used it for about 8 years. My hair is conditioned but light, not weighed down. My hair grows steadily, stays healthy.  Make sure you use as the directions suggest. I didn't at first and I wasn't happy with my results

reviews.t: Amazing shampoo/conditioner combo, love the subtle scent!
reviews.x: I was rather surprised to feel how heavy and thick the shampoo/conditioner combo is. I was expecting the same result as from similar thick conditioners but was rather happy to feel how clean the shampoo/conditioner combo rinsed after application. My hair was soft and smooth, even after blow drying. No additional product required to keep bangs neat and under control. The conditioner smells very pleasant. The pump makes dispensing super easy and mess free. It is sulfide free which makes me feel go

reviews.t: Luxurious as well as multi use
reviews.x: I love WEN.  It's different from foaming shampoo but the results are fantastic.  I use it for shampoo, leave in conditioner, mask as well as I dilute it and spray to take the frizzies throughout the day.  It gives a soft feel without weighting down my hair and making it feel greasy.  My hair is full of body and has shine for days! My mom bought me this and it is TERRIBLE! It made my hair dry like straw and break like crazy. Dollar store shampoo & conditioner works better. BTW - this isn't anything special, it's just conditioner with a touch of shampoo mixed in. Basically it's like those 2-in-1 Head & Shoulders. Stick with WalMart stuff, it's better for your hair and your wallet!

It's ok for how expensive it is. Found 10 miracle daily conditioner works even better which is less expensive, bigger bottle and works great. I have long fine, highlighted, damaged hair and get volume and super soft shiny healthy hair with 10. I would give this maybe a four star if it wasn't so expensive for the amount of the conditioner you get.

reviews.t: I was happy to find that I could order this online and ...
reviews.x: I have been using Wen products for 6 years.  I was happy to find that I could order this online and pick it up at the Amazon location the next day!  The only down side is that there is a limited selection of the products.

reviews.t: Not as thick and creamy as it usually is.
reviews.x: I am an avid user of WEN but for some reason this bottle seems to be runny and thin.  It is usually thick and creamy!  Not sure what happened.
Great shampoo. Leaves even the driest hair soft.

I use good products on my hair...alternating between Aquage and Pureology.  I learned a long time ago that there is a difference in how my hair does with  salon products as opposed to store bought. reviews.t: Leaves my hair soft and shiny
reviews.x: I have very thick, shoulder-length hair with a pretty, natural curl. Many conditioners leave my hair soft but pretty much straight.  When I use this conditioner, it leaves my hair soft and shiny, and tames the curl to a soft wave.  I love that this conditioner leaves me with two simple, easy choices for how to wear my hair depending on my mood.  I also LOVE the smell of it.

I tried this at my sisters and decided to purchase.  It smells wonderful - clean and fresh.  It makes your hair feel clean and fresh and very shiny.  The down side is that you cannot use it everyday because it can buildup and make your hair feel weighted.  I have been using a small amount twice a week (in between regular shampooing) .  It is a good "off and on" product

Love this shampoo. Makes my hair feel amazing. No frizz even in this humidity and so shiny. People keep telling me how healthy it looks. Love it but it is expensive. I wish I could get this on Subscribe and save so I can get it on the regular but at least a little discount.

Love, love, love! I’m in my 50’s, and my hair started coming in coarse. Wen turned back time. My hair is soft with Wen, holds a style for days, and keeps its volume. I still get compliments. I’ve tried going back to expensive shampoo, not worth the cost to my hair quality.

i have short platinum grey natural hair .. this makes it soft and shine. forget buying shampoo and conditioner when you have it ALL in one. i love it. and i love that he does not do animal testing. win win.

claims.text: Many reviewers say it leaves hair soft, silky, and moisturized, even for dry or frizzy hair.
Several reviewers report their hair looks healthier and more manageable, with some receiving compliments.
Some reviewers complain the product is too expensive for the results.
A few reviewers report negative results such as dryness, breakage, or hair thinning.
Some reviewers note inconsistency in texture, finding it runny or thin rather than thick and creamy.
